title: 美国加息：比特币反而涨，OKX总裁称更像猴市？
speaker: Gracie Chen

segments.en: Gracie, it's interesting, a monkey. Can you first tell us a little bit more about why you're not ready to call this a bull market just yet?
segments.zh: Gracie，很有意思，先说「猴市」。能否先谈谈，为什么你还不愿称之为牛市？

segments.en: Well, for bull market or bear market to be more valid, we need to see a more long-term trend and instead of a wide range of changes or shifts.
segments.zh: 要判断牛市或熊市是否成立，需要看到更长期的趋势，而不是大范围的反复变化。

segments.en: And if you get to compare 2026 with 2022, which was the last bear market, this 2026 might be more similar to that. And yet, there is also interest rate hike in the US
segments.zh: 如果把2026年与上一轮熊市2022年相比，2026年可能更相似。但美国又处于加息环境，

segments.en: and strangely, that doesn't really change Bitcoin price in terms of going down. It's actually going up for the past few weeks and months. So it's really hard to predict the Bitcoin price right now
segments.zh: 奇怪的是，这并没有让比特币价格下行，过去几周甚至几个月反而在上涨。所以现在很难预测比特币价格，

segments.en: and that's why I think it's more of a monkey market than a pure bull and a bear market.
segments.zh: 因此我认为这更像「猴市」，而非纯粹的牛市或熊市。
